primary_sources.title: Vogt and Voigt, Holomorphic families of forms, operators and C0-semigroups
primary_sources.scope: Common-domain holomorphic closed sectorial forms give resolvent holomorphy; uniform semigroup bounds give parameter holomorphy. Original fixed-anchor remainder hypotheses checked, not arbitrary quantum geometry.

primary_sources.title: Arendt and Nikolski, Vector-valued holomorphic functions revisited
primary_sources.scope: Locally norm bounded Banach-valued holomorphic functions converging on a set with accumulation point converge compact-uniformly. No infinite-dimensional Montel assumption.
